title: Night Talk
subtitle: We all walk and talk. We all have hair and eyes. We are ... not so different from each other.

items.text: A breathtaking number of animals lie within the Zhící—a fact that only hinders their efforts to find their companions.

After weighing their options, they decide to follow Jiǔ Niángzǐ and settle in at the tavern first. The weary travelers are more than eager to relieve their fatigue after journeying non-stop for so long.
And they've more than earned it, because strange things have indeed happened to them, non-stop for several days.
Yard, Tavern

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Madam ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What do you think about Jiǔ Niángzǐ's words? Could that be "Ask and Acquire"?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Jumping over a broken bridge is like "jumping over a canyon or climbing over a mountain." It's a condition that cannot be met, like those merchants said.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: An inevitable price?
Both of them fall silent, lost in thought.
However, Bessmert's doubts do not seem to have fallen on deaf ears, as Jiǔ Niángzǐ responds while walking out from the tavern.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Are you talking about the broken bridge outside the city?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I'm so sorry. The chairs in the lobby have not been cleaned yet. Please take a seat here, just for now.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Oh, don't worry about it. Thank you for letting us stay here.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: As for the broken bridge we talked about ... can you tell me more about it?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Hmm, when I first got here, the bridge was already broken.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Beneath that is a deeeep canyon. Across that canyon stands the Yuān Temple. You can't see it from the other side of the bridge. It's surrounded by fog. So, I'm not sure if there really is a temple there or not.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: The Yuān Temple ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: They said you can talk to Zhíxú in the Yuān Temple. Be faithful and ask It. It will answer you.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What did they call this? "The Divination," I think? They also said that the fog was strange. You can't stay there for long, or you'll pass out or get overexcited ... Well, I haven't seen such things so far.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But even so, people of that time still rushed there and prayed. Doesn't it mean that The Divination is for real? After the bridge was broken, no one's wish was ever granted.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Seems odd. There was already a bridge in the first place. Why wouldn't people rebuild it in all these years?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I can answer this one! The river dried out. People couldn't swim across, and the cliffs between the mountains were too dangerous to jump over.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But, if one can be the new Xiángruì, the problem will be solved.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: The Xiángruìs are awesome! They protect the city, help the people ... There's nothing they can't do ...
As she speaks, she sinks into her own personal contemplation.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Never mind. We'll check the striped horses in the Zhící again tomorrow.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Alright, I'll go with you! It's time to rest now. I got the rooms cleaned for you upstairs.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: And here, take the liquor with you. They can help you sleep tight!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: You got to have some.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Sorry, Ms. Jiǔ Niángzǐ. I don't drink, neither does Madam Bessmert.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Why did you call me "Ms." twice?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Um, if you want some water, wait a second, please. The water jars are on the other side of the yard. I'll get it for you.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Oh, I can do it myself. You don't have to ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: It's fine. There is no light near the jar. You need to cross a stream. I'm afraid you might get lost ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Thank you.
Once the girl's voice and figure are obscured by the night, Yenisei turns to look at Bessmert.
She seems puzzled, or perhaps, just tired.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: There were so many different striped horses in the Zhící. I couldn't recognize them at all.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: We are going to get up early tomorrow. Please have some water and go to bed.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: I'm not thirsty, thank you. But I do feel like some rest.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Okay. I'll take you to the room.
The girl returns from fetching water, only to find Yenisei alone in the hallway.
Looking around and not seeing Bessmert, she walks over and naturally sits where Bessmert sat earlier.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I didn't see you from there. I thought you went to sleep.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Oh, sorry. Madam Bessmert is tired, so ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Thank you for helping us.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Don't bother. Here's the water.
As she takes up the ceramic cup, Yenisei is slightly surprised.

In her mind, a material like this is one of two extremes—crudeness and finesse, one of handmade rough bowls used by the populace, and the latter of delicate treasures owned only by the rich nobles ...
Yet this cup is a combination of the two extremes—it's used by an ordinary tavern owner, but it is marked by a refined, tasteful aesthetic.
She rubs the side of the cup with her fingers, gently brushing across the painted patterns, as if feeling a fine porcelain vase.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: The cup ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What's wrong?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: It looks expensive.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: It's a gift I received. I don't know how much it costs, but it's delicate, isn't it?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Yes, it is delicate.
Yenisei feels compelled to rub the surface of the ceramic cup again, as though she cannot bear to part from it, and loses herself in thought.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: The pattern is a Lùshǔ, also a kind of Xiángruì.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: See? It's majestic. The tail is like the sunset clouds. I really like it. I hope you do too.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Majestic indeed. And it looks a bit like those striped horses in the Zhící. Both of them are similar to horses.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Hmm ... but people still think they are horses. Don't they?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Sure, they do. I think this species is native to Pèi City. It's an interesting discovery and will help enrich our travel notes.
Jiǔ Niángzǐ lowers her head to look at the cup in her own hand. Yenisei can smell a fermented aroma emanating from within, like kvass, but without the sweet aroma of wheat.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: She is in bed now. I can only drink it for her.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Your drink smells good. Is this the liquor that helps one sleep tight?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Not exactly. It's just unfiltered liquor.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Sounds like you have a lot of different kinds of liquor here.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Sure, we do. There are a lot of different liquors. The unfiltered ones, the clear ones, the ones made of herbs, the fine ones ... and on and on. Bedtime liquor is made of herbs with Spine Date Seeds.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I thought liquor was just liquor. At least there aren't so many types in my hometown.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Well, to be honest, I too have no idea why they are still "liquor," though they have different names.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: If the color is the standard to classify them, then what am I when I'm wearing different colored clothes? Am I not Jiǔ Niángzǐ anymore?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Haha.
Shocked, Yenisei cannot help but break into a laugh.
Seeing the other girl smile, Jiǔ Niángzǐ's eyes begin to sparkle. She nods and decides to go one step further and express her thoughts.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: That is to say, if your teammates are turned into horses or other animals in different colors, are they not your teammates anymore?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: They are, of course ...
Yenisei stops talking. This childish conversation might have caused her to erupt with laughter, but the weight of the situation is still acute, and her worries swell deep within her.
The chirping of birds in the cold night gently blankets the sound of her anxious breathing.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I'm worried, actually.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Well, maybe not just worried. I don't know.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Looks like you really miss your teammates.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: "Miss" them?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I ... I won't use this word to describe my feeling.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: All I'm thinking is, they were turned into animals because I gave them the wrong direction.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What if ... What if they can't turn back to who they really are ...
The frankness of her own inquiry unmasks the long unease Yenisei had been harboring since entering this strange city.
After speaking, she holds her breath and controls the impulse to turn back and look toward Bessmert. For a moment she is no longer even sure of where she is.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But I don't think that will happen! Things won't get any worse.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: There must be a way. I promise!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Like the clouds turn colorful, pool water gets sweet like liquor ... There are many signs of auspiciousness. They just need time.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Think about it, what if the story about the Yuān Temple is real? Maybe, maybe there will be another way for you to recognize your teammates.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Even if the feather man is not a Xiángruì, there are other Xiángruìs in the city.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: All in all ...
Jiǔ Niángzǐ racks her brain to find another way to persuade Yenisei, but is stopped by the other girl before she can begin.
Despite the cultural differences between the two of them, Yenisei feels a surge of warmth from her brief trembling words.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Thank you, Ms. ... No, Jiǔ Niángzǐ.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I see what you mean. I really do.
Yenisei takes a deep breath and exhales both calm emotions and words together, so that like a light white smoke they soon drift away.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Thank you.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: It's nothing! I will definitely help you!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Oh, here are some other Spine Date seeds. Drink the water, and I'll go make you a cup of tea with the seeds. It also helps you sleep ...
Jiǔ Niángzǐ shoots up to immediately rummage around in the bag beside her as she urges Yenisei to drain what is left in her cup.
Yenisei drinks down all of the cold, sweet water and hands the still-compelling cup back to her ...
She then watches Jiǔ Niángzǐ step onto the porch and run back into the hall at a trot.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: *exhales*
She takes a long breath and turns to look at the arid night sky.
It seems even in a strange city like this, she can enjoy the same bright moonlight as the steppes.
